name: seat-router
description: Routes marked Agent calls through durable external seats

heavySeats.title: Heavy tasks: models (leave as auto)
heavySeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

standardSeats.title: Standard tasks: models (leave as auto)
standardSeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

lightSeats.title: Light tasks: models (leave as auto)
lightSeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

busyAt.title: Busy at % used (leave at 80)
busyAt.description: The mod moves a seat to another model once one's 5-hour or weekly quota is this used, or its week is used faster than it has passed.

mixFanouts.title: Mix model families in reviews (leave on)
mixFanouts.description: Asks the session to add a seat per other model family beside the Claude agents in every review or verification fan-out.

delegate.title: Delegate code work: auto, on or off (leave as auto)
delegate.description: Sends features, fixes and PR owners to owner seats on your other CLIs: auto while Claude's quota is busy, on always, off never. /seats setup asks it too.

claudeAccounts.title: Other Claude accounts (leave empty)
claudeAccounts.description: Claude subscriptions on this machine besides the session's own, as comma-separated <name> <config folder>, e.g. work ~/.claude-work. A seat line naming one (seat: work standard reviewer) runs Claude on that account.
